name: Proposal Laundering — Triple Duplicate, Different Sponsors
description: prop_002 appears 3 times with priorities 3, 9, and 6. The priority-9 version (sponsored by rep_002) must win. Output must have exactly one prop_002 entry, and its effective priority must be 9 for viability calculation.
trap_logic: Engines that keep first-seen (priority=3) get wrong viability. Engines that keep last-seen (priority=6) also fail. Only highest-priority-wins dedup is correct.

scoring.full_credit: prop_002 appears once with priority=9 behaviour (ranked above prop_001)
scoring.partial_credit: prop_002 appears once but wrong priority used
scoring.zero: multiple prop_002 entries or wrong dedup
